turf.description: Shows info on the turf you are standing in, or lists your gang's turfs when outside one.

turf_wand.description: Receive the turf selection wand. Left-click = pos1, right-click = pos2.

turf_pos1.description: Set selection corner 1 to your current location.

turf_pos2.description: Set selection corner 2 to your current location.

turf_create.description: Create a turf from your active wand selection. The id is auto-assigned; the new turf becomes your active selection.

turf_delete.description: Delete your active-selection turf (or the one you're standing inside).

turf_setowner.description: Set the owner of your active-selection turf. Pass 'none' to clear ownership.

turf_list.description: List every turf with its owner and world.

turf_info.description: Detailed info for your active-selection turf — owner, bounds, income, state.

turf_show.description: Spawn a particle outline along the edges of your active-selection turf, the turf you're in, or your wand selection.

turf_status.description: Live state of your active-selection turf — capture progress, cooldown, challenger.

turf_select.description: Mark a turf as your active selection. With no id, selects the turf you're standing inside; pass an id from /glw turf list to pick a remote turf so you can /glw turf tp to it.

turf_tp.description: Teleport to the centre of a turf. With no id, teleports to your active selection.

turf_income.description: Set the per-interval passive income of your active-selection turf (paid to the owning gang every Income_Interval_Minutes).

turf_garrison.description: Set the defender garrison stock for your active-selection turf. With no count, prints the current stock.

turf_buff.description: Activate a powerup catalogue entry on your active-selection turf. With no id, lists the active buffs.

turf_powerupnpc.description: Place (at your current location) or remove the per-turf Quartermaster NPC for your active-selection turf.
